title: Zero GitHub dependency: remove the GitHub hook files and refuse their return
goal: CEO 2026-11-11: "0 dependency on github, remove all github hooks". Delete the tracked .github/ directory (issue, pull-request and discussion templates and the Copilot instructions file; workflows were already removed 2026-11-06), drop it from the governance tests and docs that listed it, and add a guard in tests/no_github_coupling.rs that fails when any GitHub-only integration file is tracked. Server-side webhooks: none exist on either repository (read-only listing, 2026-11-11). The .githooks/ git hooks are git-native and reference no GitHub feature, so they stay.
